_comment: Site changelog (changelog.html). Newest first. ONLY new features and pages, not small fixes. One entry: date, category, short title, 1-3 short points, optional page link and screenshots — "shots": [...] (icons/changelog/*.webp, made by tools/changelog_shots.py; 2+ shots = a carousel). Categories: Patch Reader, Materials, Hero Lab, Dynamics, Site.
